evidence: Homepage lists 8 job openings with title, company, location, salary, date, and skills visible.
Each job card displays title, company, location, salary range, posted date, industry, job type, and skills.
Industry filter (Technology -> 2 jobs), Location filter (Remote -> 2 jobs), Job Type filter (Contract -> 1 job) all correctly narrowed results.
Searching "Python" correctly returned only the Data Analyst job which has Python as a skill.
Job list count and results updated immediately after each filter/search change without page reload.
Job detail page for Senior Frontend Developer shows full description, responsibilities, requirements, and required skills (React, TypeScript, CSS, Node.js).
Application form with Full Name, Email, Phone, Cover Letter/Message fields present; submission succeeded with confirmation toast "Application submitted!".
Empty form submission blocked by required-field HTML5 validation; invalid email "not-an-email" blocked with message "Please include an '@' in the email address."
Valid application submitted without failure; toast notification "Application submitted! Your application for Senior Frontend Developer at TechCorp Solutions has been sent." appeared immediately.

actual: Submitted a second application to the same job (job-1) using identical name (Test User) and email (test.user@example.com). The system accepted it and displayed the same "Application submitted!" success toast with no warning or rejection of the duplicate.

evidence: Created "QA Automation Engineer" job with title, industry, employment type, location, salary range, description, and skill. Toast "Job posted successfully!" appeared and job now shows in dashboard listings.
Clicking "Post Job" with all fields empty did not submit; browser required-field validation blocked it and focused the first invalid field (Job Title).
Employer Dashboard "Your Job Listings" section lists all posted jobs (6 active jobs) for the logged-in employer, including the newly created QA Automation Engineer job.
Clicking the applications count button on "Senior Frontend Developer" expanded a list of 4 applications with applicant name, contact info, date, and message, visible directly in the dashboard.

Applications list clearly distinguishes applicants: Test User, Test User (dup), Alex Johnson (alex.j@email.com, 555-0101), Maria Garcia (maria.g@email.com, 555-0102), each with distinct name, email, and message.

issue: No edit functionality for job listings
actual: Delete works correctly (confirmed via dialog, job removed and Active Jobs count decremented from 6 to 5). However, no edit control exists anywhere on the job listing card, dashboard, or job title — only an applications-count button and a delete (trash) button are present. Job titles are not links and no edit icon/menu was found in the DOM.

issue: No access control restricting job posting to employers only
actual: The "Post a Job" link and /employer/post-job page are accessible to anyone browsing the site without any login, authentication, or role check. There is no job-seeker vs employer account distinction anywhere in the app, so any visitor (including job seekers) can freely create job postings.
